channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • True Blue Fellowship 2027
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
3 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 06 Jul 2026 (06 Jul to 12 Jul 2026).

  • Global Artivism: Governance Fellow
    Global Artivism (a fiscally sponsored project of Res Publica US Inc.) · deadline Closed 16 Jul 2026 · USD 1,200 to 1,800 per month (independent contractor fee), paid on receipt of monthly invoices. No employee benefits, paid leave, or insurance; contractor covers their own taxes and compliance.
    https://www.abm-intelligence.com/governancefellow-globalartivism
  • Global Artivism: Operations Fellow
    Global Artivism (a fiscally sponsored project of Res Publica US Inc.) · deadline Closed 16 Jul 2026 · USD 1,000 to 1,500 per month (independent contractor fee), paid on receipt of monthly invoices. No employee benefits, paid leave, or insurance; contractor covers their own taxes and compliance.
    https://www.abm-intelligence.com/operationsfellow-globalartivism
  • IIAS: Asia in the World Fellowship Programme 2027-2028
    International Institute for Asian Studies (IIAS), Leiden University · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Leiden phase: EUR 1,250 per month stipend plus EUR 1,200 per month housing allowance, plus a travel grant; the Phase 1 stipend at the co-host institution is set by that institution. No application fee.
    https://www.iias.asia/fellowships/asia-in-the-world

item.title: 6 new grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
6 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 15 Jun 2026 (15 Jun to 21 Jun 2026).

  • Iméra: 'This Is Not Another Fellowship' – Postdoctoral Residency 2026-27 (Aix-Marseille)
    Iméra – Institute for Advanced Study at Aix Marseille Université · deadline Closed 03 Jul 2026 · Free accommodation in campus apartment; travel expenses covered; office in co-working space. No cash stipend specified. No application fee.
    https://www.imera.fr/en/this-is-not-another-fellowship-application-2026-27/
  • TBA21-Academy: Tentacular Fellowship 2026-2027 (Ocean Space, Venice)
    TBA21-Academy, with NICHE Centre for Environmental Humanities and the UNESCO Chair on Water, Heritage and Sustainable Development at Ca' Foscari University · deadline Closed 05 Jul 2026 · Total fellowship support EUR 26,000. Phase 1 (incubation): EUR 3,000 grant for independent research and initiative development. Phase 2 (activation): EUR 8,000 grant plus a EUR 15,000 activation budget. No application fee.
    https://tba21.org/oceanspace-research-tentacular-fellowship
  • Longview Philanthropy: Digital Minds Research Fellowships 2026
    Longview Philanthropy · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · $55,000–$120,000/year through a university, or $80,000–$150,000/year direct stipend; plus research budget (10% of salary), conference travel, and compute resources where applicable. No application fee.
    https://www.longview.org/request-for-proposals-research-and-applied-work-on-digital-minds/
  • Kometa Fellows 2026: Field Journalism, Photography, and Writing
    Kometa (French literary and journalism magazine) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · €10,000 per Fellow, six Fellows selected. No application fee.
    https://kometarevue.com/page/fellows
  • Canon Foundation in Europe Research Fellowships 2026 (Europe–Japan Exchange)
    Canon Foundation in Europe · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000 per year (pro-rated for shorter stays). No application fee.
    https://portal.canonfoundation.org/
  • Fulbright-Iméra Mediterranean Studies Award 2027-2028 (Aix-Marseille, US Faculty)
    Iméra – Aix Marseille Université, in partnership with the Fulbright Commission · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · €2,400 (~USD 2,600) monthly stipend; fully covered accommodation (valued USD 788–1,966/month); €1,200 (~USD 1,300) travel allowance. No application fee.
    https://fulbrightscholars.org/award/fulbright-imera-mediterranean-studies-award-aix-marseille-university

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 11 May 2026 (11 May to 17 May 2026).

  • Taiwan AID: 2026 NGO Fellowship Program (Asia and Pacific Islands)
    Taiwan Alliance in International Development (Taiwan AID) · deadline Closed 01 Jun 2026 · Fully funded: round-trip airfare, accommodation (dormitory-style rooms, 6-8 beds per room), meals, and local transportation in Taiwan are all covered. NO artist fee, stipend or honorarium.
    https://www.taiwanaid.org/en/news/50124
  • Camargo Foundation: Fellowship 2027-2028
    Fondation Camargo · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · EUR 3,500 stipend (EUR 350 per week for 10 weeks), basic transportation to and from Cassis, a furnished apartment on campus, and a studio or appropriate workspace, plus a reference library, music and conference room and open-air theatre. Art materials, technical equipment and shipping of artworks are NOT provided. No application fee listed.
    https://camargofoundation.org/en/camargo-fellowship-2026-2027
